# Rocket Draft

> Rocket Draft is a free, fan-made Rocket League esports game that runs in the browser, on desktop and mobile, with nothing to download. It has two main modes: an RLCS draft game (draft real RLCS lineups from 2016 to today, then play the Swiss stage and the playoffs) and Road to Worlds, a Rocket League career mode where you manage an RLCS club: found it, sign real players and coaches, run the finances and chase the World Championship.

Not affiliated with Psyonix, Epic Games or the RLCS. Player overalls are Rocket Draft's own ratings. English, with a Portuguese (Brazil) version under /pt.

## Play

- [Rocket Draft](https://rocketdraft.app/): the RLCS draft game and every mode
- [Road to Worlds — Rocket League career mode and manager game](https://rocketdraft.app/rocket-league-manager): what the career mode is, how it plays, and where to start
- [How to play](https://rocketdraft.app/how-to-play): the draft, chemistry and the bracket
- [RLCS tournament simulator](https://rocketdraft.app/rocket-league-simulator)
